_comment: The de facto compiler pin. See docs/compiler-identification.md and AGENTS.md. The two -mllvm knobs are hidden backend diagnostics used as a reproduction device, not real vendor build settings; -mcpu is deliberately absent. -mfpu=neon-fp-armv8 (the Cortex-A57 AArch32 feature set): the original .text provably contains ARMv8-A FP instructions that -mfpu=vfpv4-d16 cannot emit (vseleq/vselgt/vselge, vmaxnm/vminnm, vrintm/vrinta, vcvtp — ~2,946 words in ~1,041 functions) plus NEON (vmax/vmin/vdup/vld1 — ~318 functions). The former 'VFP-only, NEON off' pin was fitted to the trivial leaf band (median matched body 8 B) and is too low; recompiling the PoC probes with neon-fp-armv8 leaves 6/7 instruction-identical (only the struct-copy probe differs: clang lowers 16-byte copies to NEON 'vld1/vst1', the original uses integer 'ldm/stm'). -mfloat-abi=hard: the original crosses the ABI with floats in the VFP s-registers (hardfp), not integer r0-r3 (softfp, clang's default for armv8a-none-eabi). Without it a float arg/result compiles to 'str r1'/'mov r0' instead of 'vstr s0'/'vmov s0' — the systematic near-miss class documented in docs/compiler-identification.md. The -isystem entries add the standard-library headers the target needs: libc++ (shipped with this clang at <CLANG_HOME>/include/c++/v1) layered on picolibc's C headers (/usr/lib/picolibc/arm-none-eabi/include, installed by the devcontainer's picolibc-arm-none-eabi package). -D_LIBCPP_HAS_NO_THREADS is required because the bare-metal target has no thread API. Headers and that define do not change generated code (they only make standard C++ compile), so they cannot affect byte-matching. One source of truth, consumed by tools/ledger/bytegate.py and tools/build/gen_compile_db.py.
